Sub: Delegation of Administrative & Financial Powers — Reg.

Sir,

A comprehensive revision of present Delegation of Administrative and Financial Powers
in the Organisation is underway. It is proposed to review all the existing delegations and also
consider any new delegation of powers required for the field offices. It is therefore requested
that your views / suggestions may please be forwarded to the undersigned to reach on or before
10 June 2016. Please ensure to give the type of delegation, Financial or Administrative,
Authority and extent of powers required, justification for the requirement, etc. clearly.

Yours faithfully,
